title: Video execution Native authority
$comment: Migration 0281 adds durable, realm-bound video tracker claims and immutable route intents. Claim takeover and route reservation serialize on the Labeling Job followed by the Jobs execution row. A tracker routing scope is admitted only when its exact claim is atomically bound in the same transaction.

public_functions.semantics: The existing 19 actions are delegated unchanged to the frozen 0279 dispatcher; successful begin_attempt replays for tracker scopes are returned only while their exact current claim binding remains live.
Migration 0281 wraps the frozen 0280 RPC and advertises the fourth exact Inference function in policy; prepare, status and finish behavior remain delegated unchanged.

jobs.name: claim
jobs.semantics: Locks video_tracker_jobs then the private execution row. QUEUED jobs may create generation 1; legacy RUNNING jobs without a durable row are refused. Expired claims rotate generation, worker and token while keeping the logical run_id stable. Terminal jobs enter recovery_required only when an existing bound route intent still needs scope cleanup; missing canonical Jobs with retained execution authority can only rotate into recovery_required cleanup. Neither cleanup path can acquire a scope or write.

jobs.name: renew
jobs.semantics: Only the current unexpired proof may renew. A cancellation marker or CANCELLED state does not invalidate the current claim while it finishes partial cancellation handling. Missing, cancelled or other terminal Jobs may renew an exact recovery_required cleanup claim, with no business-write authority restored.

jobs.name: guard
jobs.semantics: Holds the canonical Job and execution locks through the caller's transaction. Progress and partial stage/cancel/fail may finish under the current claim after cancellation; start and mask-root writes may not.

jobs.name: release
jobs.semantics: Expires the exact current claim only when no intent could have admitted: no intent, or every run intent is prepared with an exact immutable rejection receipt and no Native scope/permit. Unknown and bound intents remain recovery_required; history is retained.

inference.name: prepare
inference.semantics: Stores the complete canonical video_acquire command before any backend request. The exact claim and route intent locks remain held through the transaction. A previous bound scope is superseded only when 0280 contains a completed same-realm retirement and its scope is reconciled.

inference.name: reserve
inference.semantics: Uses the existing Python candidate set. A one-use transaction permit allows only this fixed RPC to insert operation=tracker; Native scope reservation and Jobs execution binding commit atomically.

inference.name: status
inference.semantics: Returns the latest immutable route intent for the exact current claim and its scope view if bound; it does not mutate intent or infer recovery.

inference.name: record
inference.semantics: Writes or verifies the immutable video_acquire command receipt in the same caller-owned transaction. It covers both a bound scope result and a pre-reservation policy rejection without changing the frozen 0279 action set.

private_tables.name: aap_jobs_v1.video_execution_authority
private_tables.semantics: The authority secret is private to Jobs code and usable only in the original database OID/name and PostgreSQL cluster system-identifier realm.

private_tables.name: aap_jobs_v1.video_executions
private_tables.semantics: One durable execution generation per canonical video tracker job. It intentionally has no FK back to the deletable public Job, preserving existing deletion behavior while retaining private recovery evidence; missing Jobs are never admitted or writable. Raw bearer token is never stored.

private_tables.name: aap_jobs_v1.video_execution_route_intents
columns: scope_id uuid v5 from request_id unique
private_tables.semantics: Private durable command authority; the complete command contains the lease proof but is encrypted using the database-local Jobs authority secret and never returned or logged. Prepared intents without a scope can be safely superseded on a later generation; bound intents cannot be replaced before exact 0280 retirement.

private_tables.name: aap_inference_routing_v1.video_execution_scope_permits
private_tables.semantics: A private one-use transaction-scoped insert permit consumed by the scope trigger; no routing LOGIN table access.

guards: All claim and intent operations lock Labeling video_tracker_jobs before Jobs video_executions.
Route scope insertion and Jobs route binding happen in one transaction; the permit expires with that transaction and is consumed once.
A stale generation cannot bind or reserve a scope, start or replay a backend attempt to mint a fresh admission token, or extend its scope heartbeat after takeover.
At most one prepared intent exists per job and generation; reserve, bind and receipt recording compare-and-set the current execution pointer.
Already-admitted requests remain tracked by Native routing and exact 0280 scope retirement; claim expiry is not proof of request completion.
The fixed video execution LOGIN gets one function and no raw table or sequence privileges. The Inference routing LOGIN keeps four fixed functions and no raw table rights.
Window checkpoint/restart is not enabled by this migration; recovery-required claims fail closed.
Successful video_acquire command_status receipts recheck the current binding and live scope, preventing ambiguous-commit fallback from returning stale execution success.
